To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the baryon number violation and CP violation required for successful electroweak Baryogenesis can be generated by the top quark sector in a Composite Higgs model with a light gauge singlet scalar.

(i) the singlet scalar in composite Higgs models can provide the necessary ingredients for successful baryogenesis; (ii) this is possible even when the Higgs is composite and the top quark is a pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone boson; (iii) the model can be consistent with the current bounds from LHC and electroweak precision measurements.
composite Higgs model with a gauge singlet scalar can provide all necessary ingredients to generate the baryon number asymmetry in the early universe.
